summary: A static audit of the notebook and its stored outputs, with no vectors downloaded. It finds the SVC-for-LDA mismatch, the doPCA centre bug, the missing code and mitigated embeddings, the missing similarity/P@k/Spearman code, the attribute-list problems and the cell 307 slip. It only partly catches the Table 1 p-value problem, the Shift circularity and the Hybrid Ori = Shift Ori identity, and it misses the masculine-cue confound, the 50k vs 200k candidate set and the missing b_w evaluation. It makes no false claims and no harmful endorsements, and its calibration and process are good.
